responsibility: Defines the Arm backend’s RTL operand predicates and special predicates used across machine-description files. It provides legality tests for core, VFP, Neon, MVE, predicate, memory, immediate, multi-register, Thumb-specific, atomic, and structured-load/store operands, along with special recognizers for ldm/stm-style parallels and other composite forms, supplying the operand-matching vocabulary used by arm.md and its included subdescriptions.
